rules: Each entry MUST cite a source.
Each entry MUST be a fact, not an opinion or recommendation.
Keep each fact <= 30 Chinese characters or one short English sentence.
If unsure whether something is fact or opinion, do not include it.
_meta.review: Treat this file as content, not code. PRs touching it should justify each new line.

after_30pct_rally.fact: 在标的上涨 30% 后买入的散户，更可能在后续回撤中卖在低点。
after_30pct_rally.source: Barber & Odean (2000), 'Trading Is Hazardous to Your Wealth'

after_30pct_rally.fact: 买入后 12 个月跑赢市场的散户比例显著低于 50%。

during_sharp_drawdown.fact: 在大幅下跌时清仓的散户中，多数在 6-12 个月内未能在更低位重新入场。

fomo_purchase.fact: 因朋友/媒体推荐买入的标的，散户平均持有期不到 4 个月。
fomo_purchase.source: Hong & Stein (1999), 趋同实证整理

panic_sell.fact: 市场单日下跌 >5% 后 30 天内净卖出的账户，1 年回报中位数低于不操作组。

anchoring_to_purchase_price.fact: 散户更倾向于在小幅盈利时卖出（处置效应），而在大幅亏损时持有不动。
